title: Folketingets dokumenter - træningsdata
evidence_notes: Repository records describe the handover as CC BY 4.0 and pseudonymized. Human/legal confirmation of content-level scope and attribution wording is still required before candidate export.

title: StatBank Denmark
evidence_notes: Promising for verifiable table reasoning. Confirm API-specific attribution, versioning, and whether generated table bundles may be redistributed.

title: EUR-Lex
publisher: Publications Office of the European Union
evidence_notes: Split metadata (CC0), EU-owned editorial material (CC BY 4.0), and legal documents/reuse terms. Do not approve the aggregate without document-type rules.

title: Kommunale byråds- og miljø-/teknikudvalgsmøder
evidence_notes: Official card describes 9 million words from five municipalities, expressly prepared for language-model/AI development. It reports a general copyright-free assessment for minutes, exclusion of attachments, sensitive-document filtering, and pseudonymization. Absent by name from Mimir v1 Appendix A and B; exact overlap/decontamination and file-scope verification remain required before green approval.

title: Statslige Digitale Publikationer - træningsdata
evidence_notes: Official card describes 14,465 state publications assembled specifically for Danish language-model training. Some documents are OCR-derived, OCR confidence is unavailable, and a small share is non-Danish. Absent by name from Mimir v1 Appendix A and B; inspect file-level rights scope, privacy, quality, and corpus overlap before approval.

title: Danmarks Breve - træningsdata
evidence_notes: Official card describes 13,516 historical letters and labels the resource CC0/public domain, prepared for Danish language-model training. OCR is uncorrected and most Danish is historical. Absent by name from Mimir v1 Appendix A and B; prioritize as a secondary historical-language source rather than modern long-context reasoning data.

title: Det Centrale Ordregister (COR)
evidence_notes: Official card describes a CC0 index of Danish lemmas, spelling, inflection, and compound information. Absent by name from Mimir v1 Appendix A and B. Useful for lexical and morphology task generation, but not a long-context document source; treat COR EXT and other extensions as separate rights scopes.
